event_summary: A yellow marked ball remains on a black circular base while its printed face turns out of view.
raw_event_description: At the start, a yellow ball with a visible smiley-face marking sits on a black circular base on a wooden tabletop near a mirror. Across the clip, the ball stays on the base while the smiley marking shifts around the ball from facing the camera to the side and then out of view, leaving a mostly plain yellow side visible. The mirror shows a reflected view of the ball and base throughout, and the cable and surrounding furniture remain visually stationary.

reasons: The yellow ball, black base, tabletop, mirror, and cable are visible from the first frame.
The ball already appears positioned on the base at the start.
No separate start trigger is visible.
